title: Practice: Roundhouse Knee
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The owner's roundhouse knee: a knee disguised as a low roundhouse kick. Added to the app's Technique Library as Muay Thai › Roundhouse Knee (cues, mistakes, next from there). Thai: khao khong (เข่าโค้ง), the curving knee. Footage: the owner's clip 27 (ring, 2026-11-03), raw-footage/practice/p27.mp4, one shot: three rear-leg roundhouse knees facing the camera (the leg swings out low at about 0.6, 3.4 and 6.3 s, the knee turns in at 0.85, 3.6 and 6.6 s), then a lead-leg knee at 9.4 s that the cut leaves out.

props.description: The curving knee, disguised as a low roundhouse kick

cues.text: Start it like a low kick
cues.label: LOW KICK
cues.say: Coach: "The rear leg swings out low, exactly like your low kick. They drop to check it."

cues.text: Turn the knee in over the top
cues.label: TURN IN
cues.say: Coach: "Halfway through, the knee lifts and curves in over their check."

cues.text: Drive the point into the ribs
cues.label: RIBS
cues.say: Coach: "The point of the knee lands on the ribs, hip turned in behind it."

watch.fix: Swing it out low first, then turn it in
watch.label: TOO EARLY
watch.say: Coach: "Lift the knee from the start and it's just a knee. The low swing is the disguise."
